none.name: None
none.description: Static slides, instant cut. For printing-first decks.

subtle.name: Subtle
subtle.description: Crossfade between slides only; content appears at once.

professional.name: Professional (default)
professional.description: Fade/rise entrances staggered in reading order; bars grow, lines and timelines draw, big numbers count up. Optional click-to-build steps.

cinematic.name: Cinematic
cinematic.description: Professional plus mask reveals on headlines, slow image zoom and longer section transitions. Use sparingly: keynotes, launches.

pptx_fallback: PowerPoint receives native slide transitions (fade or push from the theme). Entrance effects are optional (pptx --entrances) and limited to one fade per content block. Count-up, line drawing, mask reveal and image zoom are HTML-only; PPTX shows their final state.
